## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused outcome of this change.

Related issue or `PROJECT.md` ticket:

## User and safety impact

Describe user-visible behavior and any effect on configuration preservation,
redaction, recovery, supported clients, platforms, or distribution.

## Validation

List the exact commands, tests, fixtures, and manual checks run. State any
relevant gate that remains unverified.

## Documentation and release effects

Identify changed public behavior, documentation, package metadata, or release
artifacts. Write `None` when there is no effect.

## Checklist

- [ ] This pull request addresses one accepted outcome and preserves unrelated work.
- [ ] I linked the governing issue or ticket, or explained why a small correction needs none.
- [ ] I added or updated the narrowest useful tests for changed behavior.
- [ ] I ran the applicable repository checks and listed them above.
- [ ] I used synthetic, redacted examples and included no credential, environment value, private configuration, private path, user data, or raw unreviewed log.
- [ ] This pull request contains no vulnerability details; suspected vulnerabilities use [private reporting](https://github.com/EnjoyableWork/mcp-sync/security/advisories/new).
- [ ] I updated documentation for changed user-visible or operational behavior.
- [ ] I have the right to submit this contribution under the repository's [MIT License](../LICENSE).
- [ ] I agree to follow the [Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

The project does not require a CLA or DCO `Signed-off-by` line. See
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the separate licensing choices.
